subject: Introductory distance sampling workshop, Arusha, Tanzania, Dec 5-10.

messages.author: 7482eee8d2863d12
messages.subject: Introductory distance sampling workshop, Arusha, Tanzania, Dec 5-10.
parts:
University of St Andrews, in collaboration with the Tanzania Conservation Research Centre, will be holding a 6-day workshop on distance sampling from December 5-10 in a field station near Arusha, Tanzania.

The workshop will involve practical field exercises and lab work, taking the student from basic concepts to design and analysis of a complete survey.  The course is divided into two sessions (1st: primer; 2nd analysis using Distance); participants can attend one or both.  The course instructor is Dr. Len Thomas.

The workshop is particularly aimed at participants from African nations.  Partial scholarships are available (funded by the UK Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council).

For more information, please see https://goo.gl/OP7V63

Please pass on to anyone you think may be interested.
